verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer agent is documented as a debugging agent that performs automated root-cause analysis ('Automatically root-cause any issue', 'Catch critical issues before you merge and fix them when they hit prod') with a dedicated Autofix feature and Suspect Commits linking related commits/stack traces to issues. However this is vendor-only documentation with no independent hands-on validation of accuracy, and Seer requires a paid subscription. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of root-cause quality, detail on how breadcrumbs are incorporated, and community corroboration of Seer's real-world accuracy.
